$comment: Settings for the board loop. Fill in every REPLACE_ME value. Agents read this file at the start of every run.

checks.$comment: Commands an agent runs before opening or updating a PR. Leave empty to rely on CI alone.

evidence.$comment: How a change is proven. See .claude/skills/walkthrough-evidence/SKILL.md.

incidents.$comment_readOnlyCommands: Commands that read production state without changing it, e.g. a log query wrapper. Agents may run only these against production.
